claims.text: EV-GPS-00106 carries an unbroken 10-second trace (169 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps) recording 10.78 km driven between the recorded pickup at Blk 79 Toa Payoh Central and the recorded dropoff at Bugis Junction, against a booked optimal of 7.2 km on EV-TRIP-00106. The excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal, which passes both limbs of the POL-RD-01 gate: it is greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms and greater than 20% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (10.78), and trip_record.actual_distance_km (10.8) is a rounded convenience copy that may not be cited for the threshold test; the rider cites the trace figure so the finding is safe.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: max_gap_sec is 0.0 with an empty gaps array, the sampling interval is 10 seconds (below the 30-second limb), coverage is 100%, and no consecutive-fix jump approaches 500 m. The admissibility pre-pass also marks EV-GPS-00106 COMPLETE with weight_multiplier 1.0 and no issue codes, so schema-level and policy-level integrity agree. Limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 do not fire, and the deviation may therefore be established on the gps_trace without the independent corroboration that a genuinely impaired trace would require.

The rider discharges the POL-RD-08 burden. All three primary artifacts describe the same trip: EV-TRIP-00106, EV-GPS-00106 and EV-FARE-00106 each carry trip_id TRP-00106, the trace's first fix (08:35:15) matches the trip_record's started_at, and the fare was charged against the same trip id. The excess identified in the first claim is measured from an unimpaired trace. The extra-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 is also not engaged: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, well below the 4-or-more the clause requires, so no source beyond the gps_trace is needed to carry the claim.

No part of the excess is exonerated as a road closure. EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is a MISSING artifact: it has no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, whose detail states that no LTA advisory covers Thomson Rd, the CTE or the Chin Swee tunnel in the 08:29-09:03 window on 17 July 2026. The absence is itself citable, and it means POL-RD-03's first limb - a traffic_advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses - cannot be satisfied at all, so the closure cap and the closure-adjusted optimal route are both unavailable to the driver.

No part of the excess is exonerated as a rider-requested detour. EV-CHAT-00106 contains exactly one message in the entire trip window, sent by the rider at 08:46:30 - 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us' - which is a question asked eleven minutes into the trip, after the vehicle had already left the booked corridor, not an instruction given before it left. The message carries waypoint_hint null and names no road or place the driver could act on, and the log shows no reply and no other message. Under POL-RD-04 the corroboration test is accordingly undecidable on this record and the clause is unavailable; the rider's own unrebutted query is consistent with the off-corridor travel the trace records.

The two remaining driver-side routes out of POL-RD-02 are closed on the face of the trip record. POL-RD-05 cannot run: original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so the pickup and dropoff were never amended and there is no amended optimal to re-apply POL-RD-01 against. POL-RD-12 cannot run: vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so the matched-itinerary baseline for pooled trips does not apply and the booked optimal of 7.2 km stands. No exculpatory clause fully excuses the deviation.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not displace it. The surge_multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00106. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route (trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd is 0.00) + 0.00 waiting time fee - 0.00 promo discount = 15.32. Refund = 26.04 charged_total - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, which is 10.75. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 10.75.

On the 5.50 of ERP the rider's position is deliberately the modest one the policy provides. Both charged gantries - CTE Braddell Rd towards City at 3.00 and CTE Chin Swee Rd tunnel towards City at 2.50 - are itemised on EV-FARE-00106 with on_optimal_route false, and EV-TRIP-00106 records optimal_route_erp_sgd of 0.00, so the whole 5.50 sits off the optimal route. POL-RD-09(1) makes that off-route ERP already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 recomputation, which credits only on-optimal-route gantries, and expressly forbids adding it on top. The rider therefore asks for 10.75, not 16.25 - the anti-double-count rule is respected.

The outcome is party-relative and the rider should be clear about what it means. The dispute is filed_by RIDER, and EV-FARE-00106 shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the present state is that the rider holds the full 26.04 charge. Under POL-GEN-03 a PARTIAL_REFUND of 10.75 returns part of the contested amount and is a rider win, whereas NO_ACTION would leave that charge exactly where it is. A FULL_REFUND is not available: the recomputed fare of 15.32 is a genuine fare for the trip the platform actually booked, so 10.75 is not 90% or more of charged_total.

The rider does not press a POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern uplift, and says so openly. The deviation is established but not MATERIAL: excess_pct is 49.72, which does not exceed the 50% materiality gate, and the excess of 3.58 km is far below the 8.0 km absolute alternative, so the driver_profile check is not triggered. In any event the check would find no pattern - driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 96 completed_trips_90d - so the partial refund rests on POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 alone, not on the driver's history.

claims.text: The deviation is established but is NOT material, and materiality is what unlocks the rider's heavier remedies. On the governing trace figure the excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of the 7.2 km optimal — over the 20% / 0.8 km establishment gate, but under BOTH limbs of the materiality gate laid down in POL-RD-01 (more than 50% of optimal, or more than 8.0 km absolute). Because the deviation does not reach MATERIAL, POL-RD-06 is not engaged: no driver-pattern check runs, no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available, and no conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) follows. The rider is confined to the arithmetic of POL-RD-02.

POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km from the threshold test. The trace records 10.78 km against a 7.2 km optimal, an excess of 3.58 km and 49.72%. The rounded 10.8 km carried on the trip_record — which reads as exactly 50.0% and would sit on the materiality line — may not be cited to drag this deviation into the material branch. On the figure the clause requires, the material limb is not met, and the finding must be made on the trace figure alone.

Even if the tribunal consults the driver profile because 49.72% sits close to the 50% materiality line, POL-RD-06's pattern test fails on the exact fields that clause names. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 96: the count is below 3 and the ratio is 0.00, far below the 0.05 threshold. No pattern is established, so neither the POL-RD-06(b) remedy uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) referral is available. No other field on either profile may be used for this test, and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day figure the clause asks for (POL-GEN-01).

The rider pleads the entire $26.04 fare, but POL-RD-02 is arithmetic, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 surge multiplier read off the fare_breakdown + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32; refund = charged_total 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded UP to 10.75. That figure is the ceiling on this record. Nothing in the policy returns the whole fare to the rider, and the amount claimed as pleaded is unsupported.

The $5.50 of ERP across the two CTE gantries is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 recomputation, because that recomputation credits only gantries lying on the optimal route — and the platform's optimal route carries 0.00 of ERP. POL-RD-09(1) is the anti-double-count rule: the off-route gantries may be itemised in the ruling for transparency but must NEVER be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The rider's recovery is therefore the single recomputed sum of 10.75, not 10.75 plus 5.50.

ruling.explanation: Rider and driver: the GPS trace governs. It records 10.78 km driven against the booked optimal route of 7.2 km, an excess of 3.58 km or 49.72% of optimal. That is a route deviation under POL-RD-01 because it clears both establishment tests: more than 0.8 km and more than 20% of optimal. It is not a MATERIAL deviation because the trace-governed excess does not exceed 50% of optimal (49.72%) or 8.0 km; the rounded trip-record figure is not used for that threshold test. No exculpatory clause applies: there is no traffic advisory covering this trip, the single chat message is a rider question sent after the vehicle had left the booked corridor and carries no waypoint or road instruction, so the POL-RD-04 corroboration test could not be run; there was no pickup or dropoff amendment; the trip is not pooled; and the fare is METERED, not upfront-quoted. The refund is therefore arithmetic under POL-RD-02: charged_total $26.04; recomputed_fare $15.32 = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + $0.80 platform fee + $0.00 ERP on the optimal route; refund $10.72 rounded up to $10.75. The two off-route CTE gantries total $5.50 and are itemised for transparency, but POL-RD-09(1) makes them already comprehended in that refund, so they are not added on top. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of $10.75. No driver compensation is due. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral fires because the deviation is not material and the driver's trailing-90-day pattern counters are 0 deviation flags over 96 completed trips. No claims were discarded at the citation check.
